      "eps": 68.5
    },
    {
      "year": 2023,
      "revenue_cr": 198817,
      "net_income_cr": 44500,
      "eps": 80.5
    },
    {
      "year": 2024,
      "revenue_cr": 228639,
      "net_income_cr": 52500,
      "eps": 94.5
    }
  ],
  "top_assumptions": [
    "Revenue growth reverts to ~15% CAGR (pre-COVID trend) from FY2022 onward, reflecting HDFC Bank's historical track record of 15-17% annual net revenue growth, supported by management guidance of accelerating loan growth, NIM of ~4.1%, and the government's ~9.1% real GDP growth expectation for FY2022 driving credit demand recovery.",
    "Net profit margin (PAT/Total Income) stabilises and improves modestly from ~20.5% in FY2021 toward ~22-23% by FY2024, as credit costs normalise post-pandemic (provisioning was elevated in FY2021 at ~17% of income due to COVID-related stress), and operating leverage improves with revenue scale."
  ],
  "reasoning": "FY2021 total income (consolidated) was approximately 155,885 crore (converted from \u20b91,558,852,736 thousand), growing ~6% YoY versus a historical 15-17% CAGR, marking it as anomalous due to pandemic-related credit demand suppression and elevated provisioning. Accordingly, the 5-year CAGR basis is preferred over the latest single-year growth rate, with recovery assumed from FY2022. The MD&A cites 13.4% net revenue growth, 15.5% NII growth, management focus on digital transformation and new business verticals, strong government capex, and 9.1% real GDP growth expectation for FY2022, supporting a return to ~15% revenue growth. Balance sheet remains strong with adequate capital adequacy (no leverage constraint flagged), and the new CEO has articulated a 'Run and Build' strategy signalling continued investment in franchise expansion."
}

Step 1: Identify the 3 most critical assumptions embedded in this forecast.
Step 2: For each assumption, describe one plausible scenario where it fails.
Step 3: Rate each assumption failure as Low / Medium / High risk to the forecast accuracy.
Step 4: Assign an overall confidence score from 0-100 (100 = completely certain).

Return ONLY valid JSON:

  "company": "<COMPANY>",
  "base_year": <YYYY>,
  "strategy": "<baseline|alt_strategy>",
  "assumptions": [
    {"assumption": "<text>", "failure_scenario": "<text>", "risk": "<Low|Medium|High>"}
  ],
